analysis_options.fixture_model: GetStr Funcdata over BfdArchitecture; per arm case: type-locked ScopeLocal symbol (addSymbol + setAttribute(typelock), unrestricted usepoint) attached to a register-space 8-byte Varnode via Varnode::setSymbolProperties (varnode.cc:409-421); SUBPIECE defined via newOp/opSetOpcode/opSetInput/newUniqueOut; high level via fd.setHighLevel(); SPECIAL_PRINT set via opMarkSpecialPrint; rendering through FixturePrintC::opSubpiece with pushScope(fd->getScopeLocal()) preamble (printc.cc:2597) and EmitNoMarkup
analysis_options.type_construction: FixtureTypes builds each factory type exactly once per process (a second getTypeStruct on a completed name throws 'Trying to alter definition of type', type.cc:3421-3423; setFields requires an incomplete struct, type.cc:3482). fixture_arr carries a tail field so TypeStruct::setFields does not set needs_resolution (type.cc:1569-1871) on the outer walk level; fixture_inner is deliberately single-field-fills-struct so the REAL factory DOES set needs_resolution there — that flag drives the armA.nested findResolve arm (printc.cc:1967-1971). The defining COPY and SUBPIECE are inserted into a fresh basic block (const_cast<BlockGraph&>(fd.getBasicBlocks()).newBlockBasic + opInsertEnd) so TypeStruct::findResolve's op->getParent()->getFuncdata() (type.cc:1945) is reachable
